title: Explicit Full-Spark Gabor Windows with Quantitative Phase Retrieval
summary: We construct explicit algebraic finite Gabor windows that are simultaneously full spark and phase retrievable, with quantitative control of the self-ambiguity function. In every cyclic dimension, a constant--Chu window has an exactly computable ambiguity minimum of order $N^{-3/2}$; for $N\ge25$, a two-site Chu repair has margin comparable to $dN^{-3/2}$ for every divisor $d\le\sqrt N$.
